== Acquisition ==
'''[[Signet of Capture]]'''
* [[Bramble Everthorn]] ([[The Eternal Grove (explorable area)]])
* [[Watari the Infinite]] ([[Sunjiang District (Winds of Change)]], only during [[Redemption for the Lost]])

== Notes ==
* The health property is checked after the damage is dealt.
* This is the only off-hand attack that must follow a dual attack. As a result, it is very effective if you plan to use multiple dual skills since all dual attack skills except for [[Exhausting Assault]] must follow an off-hand attack.
** Can be rotated with [[Death Blossom]] for constant [[area of effect]] damage.
** Combines well with [[Horns of the Ox]] to keep lone, tough foes (such as many [[Dungeon]] end bosses) locked down. 
* [[Watari the Infinite]] is an ally, but getting him killed by enemies during the [[Redemption for the Lost]] quest allows you to capture the skill.

== Trivia ==
* The name of this skill derives from a mathematical shape: the [[w:Möbius strip|Möbius strip]], likely because both are able to continuously loop.
